versions.name: Boulder Creek Scout Reservation
versions.address: 250 Scout Ranch Road, Boulder Creek, CA 95006
versions.summary: A Pacific Skyline Council scout reservation in the redwood forests of the Santa Cruz Mountains near Boulder Creek, spanning several ecological zones along Bear Creek, with a swimming pool, archery and rifle ranges, and family and unit campsites for year-round outdoor programs.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Pacific Skyline Council camping and reservation pages. The source labeled this Silicon Valley Monterey Bay Council, which is wrong: Boulder Creek Scout Reservation is owned and operated by Pacific Skyline Council (BSA #031) and remains open for reservations. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence and active status verified against Pacific Skyline Council pages; council corrected from the source's SVMBC to Pacific Skyline. camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a year-round weekend/family camping reservation; features unsurveyed.
